items.title: Introducing AWS Backup logically air-gapped vault support for Amazon RDS
items.summary: AWS Backup now extends logically air-gapped vault support to Amazon RDS. Learn how to protect, validate, and recover your RDS database backups with isolated, immutable vaults, along with the design, encryption, and cost considerations for a cyber recovery strategy that keeps backups recoverable even when your production account can't be trusted.
items.creator: Mounika Buragapu
